results.title: Xiaomi 18 Pro in the Wild: The Flush Camera Design That Makes the iPhone 18 Look Bulky
results.description: Xiaomi 18 Pro real-life images confirm a flush camera module that sits level with the rear display — a first for the series. With a 200MP Leica system covering 17mm to 75mm and a Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, this flagship is setting the design standard that even iPhone 18 hasn't matched.
